title: MWS Recruitment — Demographics
description: Administrative and demographic fields recorded at recruitment: birth year, recruitment year, age, region of residence, and which questionnaire version the participant completed.

RYOB.title: Year of birth
RYOB.$comment: Source states no explicit valid range for this field. Bound removed entirely -- source states no range for this field; the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104).

RYSUBMIT.title: Year of recruitment into the MWS
RYSUBMIT.$comment: Bound removed entirely -- source states no range for this field; the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104).

RAGE.title: Age at recruitment
RAGE.$comment: Source states a valid range of From=48 only (To is blank/unstated). Minimum 48 is source-stated and kept. Bound trimmed to that source-stated minimum only -- the earlier agent-decided maximum (120) was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104).

RREGION.title: Region of residence at recruitment
RREGION.description: Derived field; UK regional breast-screening-style catchment areas as recorded at recruitment.

RQTYPE.title: Questionnaire version completed
RQTYPE.description: A code determining which version of the recruitment questionnaire the participant completed. Other fields' source-stated Availability columns (Aqua/Blue/Other) reference this same three-way split.
